caveat: Only the 2026 occurrence/date and country source are verified. This is not certification of unique annual recurring identity, 2027/2028 date, founding year, translations, or runtime content. Original calendar may contain public holidays and nonannual events. Additional 31 candidates cross-checked against Japan Cabinet Office, Bank of Thailand, Singapore Ministry of Manpower and Vietnamese government calendars. No human linguistic review or multi-year recurrence approval. Plus 30 primary calendar confirmations: Canada Heritage 22, South Africa 5 fixed dates, Indonesia 3. Easter-dependent Family Day excluded until cross-year rule is separately proven.
